model_output.verdict: A senior backend engineer with payments work that shows both technical decisions and results.
write_up: This is a strong payments resume! At Lumen Ledger, you connect high-volume payouts, ledger migration and latency work to the systems you built. A recruiter can see why your background fits a senior backend role.

The balance API line is a great model: it names the technical change and shows the latency before and after. Your experience is easy to follow, and the mentoring and incident review work adds another dimension to the technical story.

For Cobalt Pay, bring any direct on-call ownership or work with Finance and Risk into the Lumen Ledger role if you did it. Your resume already makes a strong case for the engineering work; competition and referrals can also matter.
